title: Fortinet warns of 'Godzilla AI', a marketplace for malicious AI services
date_note: The page gives only its publication day; the remarks were made at a Fortinet summit reported that day.
geo_basis: Location of the Fortinet AI Cybersecurity Summit 2026 where the warning was given, as the source states it
summary: Digital Daily reports that Kapil Gupta, Fortinet's Vice President of Security Solutions, told the Fortinet AI Cybersecurity Summit 2026 in Seoul that a new marketplace called Godzilla AI has emerged. Fortinet says it offers exploit generation without mainstream AI tools' safety restrictions, with invitation-only membership. Fortinet advises organisations to check all API credentials and whether prompt files and execution logs are exposed.
plain: Fortinet says a new invitation-only online marketplace sells AI services that can generate attack code without the safety limits of mainstream AI tools. It advises organisations to check their API credentials.
exec: Fortinet says a marketplace now offers AI-generated exploit code without safety limits; it advises checking exposed API credentials, prompt files and logs.
action: Fortinet advises organisations to check all API credentials and verify whether prompt files and execution logs are exposed.

validation.note: Single publisher (Digital Daily) relaying Fortinet's own remarks; Fortinet's notice itself was not read.

review.note: title, speaker, summit, invite-only, API advice checked against Digital Daily
